changes: Path-based test run delegates TC selection to the connector. On TC failure, test logs RUN_ID --failure-attempt ATTEMPT_ID reads the saved log tails and per-board kernel evidence without claiming analysis or rerunning the test.
The connector file picker reports pending and unavailable states and preserves typed input on cancellation or failure.
With Monitor connected, saving the Linux TC root refreshes the Windows Host catalog. Reconnection retries outstanding folder changes. Clearing the selection removes the old catalog.
